title: 第三十五章 盗天贼第三十四章 渡劫炼炁修真而登仙
lines: 第三十五章盗天贼
“轰隆隆！”
外观，院落内，王平束手而立，双眼微阖，大半灵识都脱离本体，完全落在了身后的六欲浑天魔上。
霎时间，他的视野全变了。
在此之前，他眼中的世界和灵识感应到的世界并无区别，山还是山，水还是水，一切都是井然有序。
然而现在不同了。
通过六欲浑天魔的视角，灵识感应下的世界竟陡然变了一副模样，或者说，多出了一道奇异的光彩。
光彩宛若极光般弥漫在空气中，充斥在寰宇内，乍看之下似乎有无数细密的蛊虫在其中跳动，然而一转眼，又变成了涌动的波涛，两种特质被并合在一起，随着日升月落而呈现出不同的颜色。
青黄赤白黑，交替轮转。
五种颜色构筑出不同的模样，横亘在王平的视野之中，看似混杂，却又清晰地被划分为了二十四道。
如此奇景，王平立刻想到了【六欲天自在成就法】内的描述：“天地有二十四炁，节制万象之变化。”
故谓之【二十四节炁】。
传闻中，有关“炼炁”的修行，就与这【二十四节炁】相关，奈何功法内语焉不详，他也难知真相。
不过很快，随着【六欲天自在成就法】运转，王平就发现眼前充斥天地的二十四道极光中有一道起了反应，无穷色彩随着六欲浑天魔的呼吸而吹落，如瀑布一般将其包裹，又被他一点点吸入。
“咔擦！”
几乎同时，王平只觉得身子仿佛被一下子扔进了沸水之中，滚滚热意从口鼻涌入，流淌向四肢百骸。
这种感觉，就像是在融化重铸。
仿佛他的筋骨，皮肉，甚至脉络都在这股热意的作用下被溶解，然后重新打磨，锻造成全新的形状。
王平下意识地开口，却差点咬断了自己的舌头，强烈的痛楚在这个过程中疯狂冲击着他的大脑神经。
非要形容的话，就像是被人埋进了沙里，只露出了一个死人头，然后被人从头顶一刀劈了个口子，又导入水银.....那种奇痒难耐，痛苦不堪的感觉，让人忍不住想要从头顶的那个口子钻出去。
王平....没忍住。
“噗嗤！”
他猛然抬起头，从头顶的口子，那仿佛融化了他身体的热流源头处钻了出去，随后眼前就瞬间一黑。
咔擦，咔擦咔擦咔擦！
刺耳的声音不绝于耳。
腐烂的皮肤被剥落，血水从毛孔淌出，一根根青筋变得粗壮，筋骨也变得厚实，王平缓缓站直身子。
痛苦如同被解开的枷锁般落下，随之落下的还有一层破烂的人皮，强烈的畅快让王平全身都在颤抖。
脱胎换骨！
此刻的王平，就像是褪去旧皮后迎来新生的蛇蛟，显露在外的皮肤在阳光下赫然呈现出了金色光彩。
通灵识念，无漏真身，周天吐纳，借炁显法。
渡劫一重的四种修行特质，【通灵识念】王平已经修成，如今正在修行的则是第二种特质【无漏真身】。
当然，这还只是刚起步，肌肤光彩让人一眼就能看出神异，而且也流于表面，并未深入体内脉络，什么时候他真的练出了【无漏真身】，那反而会收敛所有神异，外表看上去和凡人并无区别。
下一秒，王平抬脚放下，没用什么力气，本意只是想走两步，然而脚下青砖竟就被他这一脚踩碎了！
“不可思议....”
王平在原地晃了晃，又走了两步，依旧是踏碎青砖，直到第五步才收敛力气，只踩出了一道道裂纹。
力量！
要知道此刻的他完全没用内劲，只凭借纯粹的体魄，展现出的力量竟不比当初单骑冲阵时候的他弱！
当时他还用了天魔解体大法呢！
和此刻的他相比，那些所谓的外功圆满，什么真龙筋，山君骨都是扯淡，根本没有相提并论的资格！
这合理吗？
‘好像也挺合理的，毕竟我修仙了啊.....’
站在原地，王平又挥舞了一番手臂，打了一套拳，凭借灵识辅助，这才慢慢掌控了新生体魄的力量。
content_en:
Chapter 35: Thief of Heaven
"Boom!"
From the outside, in the courtyard, Wang Ping stood with his hands tied, his eyes slightly closed, and most of his spiritual consciousness separated from his body, completely focused on the Six Desires Hound Heaven Demon behind him.
In an instant, his vision completely changed.
Before that, there was no difference between the world in his eyes and the world perceived by his spiritual consciousness. Mountains were still mountains, water was still water, and everything was in order.
But things are different now.
Through the perspective of the Six Desire Demon, the world under the induction of spiritual consciousness suddenly changed its appearance, or in other words, gained a strange brilliance.
The brilliance filled the air and filled the world like an aurora. At first glance, it seemed that there were countless fine Gu insects dancing in it. However, in a blink of an eye, it turned into surging waves. The two qualities were merged together, showing different colors as the sun rose and the moon set.
Green, yellow, red, white and black rotate alternately.
The five colors create different appearances across Wang Ping's field of vision. They seem to be mixed, but they are clearly divided into twenty-four lines.
"This is..."
With such a wonderful sight, Wang Ping immediately thought of the description in the "Six Desires and Heavenly Freedom Achievement Method": "There are twenty-four qi in the heaven and earth, which control the changes of all phenomena."
Therefore, it is called [Twenty-Four Section Qi].
According to rumors, the practice of "Qi Refining" was related to the "Twenty-Four Qi Qi". However, the details of the technique were unclear, and it was difficult for him to know the truth.
But soon, as the [Six Desires of Heavenly Freedom Achievement Method] was operating, Wang Ping found that one of the twenty-four auroras that filled the world in front of him reacted. The infinite colors blew down with the breath of the Six Desires and Heavenly Demon, wrapping it like a waterfall, and was inhaled by him little by little.
"Kacha!"
Almost at the same time, Wang Ping felt as if his body had been thrown into boiling water. Hot heat poured in from his mouth and nose and flowed to his limbs.
This feeling is like melting and recasting.
It was as if his muscles, bones, skin, and even veins were dissolved under the influence of this heat, then polished again and forged into a brand new shape.
"Holy shit!?"
Wang Ping spoke subconsciously, but almost bit off his tongue. In the process, the intense pain hit his brain nerves crazily.
If I had to describe it, it was like being buried in the sand, with only a dead head exposed, and then someone cut a hole on the top of the head, and then introduced mercury... The itching and painful feeling made people want to get out of the hole on the top of the head.
Wang Ping... couldn't hold it back.
"Pfft!"
He suddenly raised his head, and through the opening on the top of his head, the source of the heat that seemed to melt his body came out, and then his eyes suddenly went dark.
Click, click, click, click!
The harsh sound is endless.
The rotten skin was peeled off, blood flowed from the pores, the veins became thicker, and the bones became thicker. Wang Ping slowly stood up straight.
The pain fell like a shackle being released, followed by a layer of tattered human skin. The intense pleasure made Wang Ping's whole body tremble.
Reborn!
At this moment, Wang Ping was like a snake that had shed its old skin and ushered in new life. The exposed skin showed a golden brilliance in the sunlight.
Channeling the mind, the true body has no leakage, breathes in and out of the sky, and manifests the Dharma through Qi.
Wang Ping has already completed the four cultivation qualities of the first level of transcending tribulation, [Psychic Consciousness], and the second quality [Flawless True Body] is currently being cultivated.
Of course, this is just the beginning. The radiance of the skin can be seen as magical at a glance, and it is only on the surface and does not penetrate into the inner veins of the body. When he really develops the [Flawless True Body], all the magical powers will be restrained, and the appearance will look no different from ordinary people.
"Bang!"
The next second, Wang Ping raised his foot and put it down. He didn't use much strength. He just wanted to take two steps, but the green brick under his foot was crushed by his foot!
"Incredible..."
Wang Ping swayed on the spot and took two more steps, still breaking the green bricks. It was not until the fifth step that he restrained his strength and only made cracks.
strength!
You must know that at this moment, he has no internal energy at all, relying only on his pure physical strength, and the strength he shows is no weaker than when he rode alone into the battle!
At that time, he also used the method of disintegrating the demon!
Compared with him at this moment, those so-called perfect external skills, such as true dragon tendons, and tiger bones are all nonsense, and they are not qualified to be compared at all!
Is this reasonable?
'It seems quite reasonable, after all, I have become an immortal...'
Standing on the spot, Wang Ping waved his arms again and performed a set of punches. With the help of his spiritual consciousness, he slowly took control of the power of his new body.
title_en: Chapter 35: Thief of Heaven Chapter 34: Overcoming Tribulation, Refining Qi, Cultivation, and Become an Immortal
